steps.title: Prepare HEK293T Cells
steps.instruction: Plate HEK293T cells in appropriate culture vessels (e.g., T75 flask) to achieve 70-80% confluency on the day of transfection.

steps.title: Prepare DNA and Transfection Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA mixture and the transfection reagent solution separately.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA tubes containing 10.5 ug of plasmid, 3.5 ug of VSVG plasmid, 7.0 ug of dR8.91 plasmid, and 1 ml OptiMEM.
Add 60 ul of X-tremeGENE to 1 ml of OptiMEM for each flask.

steps.title: Perform Transfection
steps.instruction: Combine the DNA and transfection solutions and apply to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Mix the DNA solution and X-tremeGENE solution and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Use a 5ml pipet to add the transfection mixture dropwise to the flask and gently swirl to mix.
Incubate overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Harvest and Process Lentivirus
steps.instruction: Collect the viral supernatant and prepare it for storage.

substeps.instruction: Collect media from the flask into a 15 ml tube.
Replace the collected media with 12 ml of Astrocyte Growth Media (AGM) and return the flask to the incubator.
Spin down collected media for 10 min at 1100 rpm to pellet dead cells and debris.
Filter the collected media through a 0.45 μm syringe filter.
Test for viral particles using Lenti-X GoStick (Clonetech): add 20 ul of media to the stick, then add 4 drops of chase solution; a faint second band should appear within 5-10 min if virus is present.
Aliquot the lentivirus and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Clean Up Transfection Vessels
steps.instruction: Decontaminate and discard the production flasks.

substeps.instruction: Add bleach solution to the flask to kill remaining viral particles.
Aspirate and discard the flask.

steps.title: Prepare Astrocytes for Transduction
steps.instruction: Plate rat primary astrocytes for transduction experiments.

substeps.instruction: Plate rat primary astrocytes (at DIV7) in 6-well dishes at a density of 300,000-400,000 cells/well.

steps.title: Transduce Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Apply the lentivirus to the astrocyte cultures.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve lentivirus aliquots from -80°C on ice.
Remove 500 ul of media from each well to be treated.
Add 500 ul of lentivirus and 1 ug/mL polybrene (optimize titration for desired efficiency).

steps.title: Puromycin Selection and Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform puromycin selection starting two days after lentivirus addition (DIV10).

substeps.instruction: Prepare puromycin-supplemented media by adding puromycin to AGM at 2 ug/mL in a 50 ml tube and equilibrating.
Remove 1 ml of media from astrocytes and add 1 ml of media containing puromycin to a final concentration of 1 ug/mL.
Two days later (DIV12), repeat puromycin feeding using AGM + puromycin at 2 ug/mL.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse the astrocytes three days after the last puromycin feed (DIV15, day 5 of puromycin treatment).
